sections.title: When to use
sections.markdown:
- Centered layouts where the theme should open symmetrically from a middle seam.
- Pages where the switch position varies, since the split does not depend on where the button sits.

sections.title: When not to use
sections.markdown:
- Use theme-switch for a reveal that grows from the button itself.
- Use theme-switch-rise for the calmest option in product UI.

sections.title: Keyboard interactions
sections.markdown:
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | Toggles the theme. |

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.markdown:
- Same button as theme-switch: aria-pressed reflects dark mode and the label names the next theme.
- Keep the split reveal off for reduced motion and swap the theme directly.

sections.title: Motion
sections.markdown:
- variant="split": the next appearance opens from a slim center seam; run it in onThemeChange with a view transition.
- The icon shifts 1px right in dark mode.
- Reduced motion removes the nudge and swaps the icon with a fade.

sections.title: Responsive behavior
sections.markdown:
- The labelled button fits a desktop top bar; pass iconOnly for a fixed 38px square on narrow headers and mobile.
- Hover styles apply only on hover-capable fine pointers, so touch taps do not leave a stuck hover state.

sections.title: Performance
sections.markdown:
- The button itself is tiny: one icon swap on a spring, and the first theme after hydration applies without animating.
- The page transition is yours; a full-page view transition snapshots the whole document, so keep it short and skip it for reduced motion.

sections.title: Notes for AI
sections.markdown:
- Select with variant="split". The prop only styles the icon nudge and is passed back to onThemeChange; the page animation is your code.
- Split is symmetric and does not depend on where the button sits, so it suits centered layouts.
